task: Take the BOX_MIDDLE of the box and place it on INSPECTION_TABLE. After that, the stack should look like it is removed the middle box ONLY. NOTE: only the top box of the box stack can be picked(like the data structure).
plan_summary: Move BOX_TOP to TEMP_TABLE to access BOX_MIDDLE, then move BOX_MIDDLE to INSPECTION_TABLE, and finally move BOX_TOP to INSPECTION_TABLE to restore the stack order without the middle box.
assumptions: BOX_TOP is graspable and must be removed first due to stack constraints.
TEMP_TABLE serves as a valid temporary storage location.
The robot can navigate to all specified coordinates within tolerance.
